description.name: Cyberfly Auto Accept
description.tagline: Auto-accept paid pending orders; optionally delete stale unpaid pending orders.
description.short: Accepts Pending orders immediately when the invoice is Paid, and can delete Unpaid Pending orders older than a set number of hours.
description.long: Cyberfly Auto Accept watches InvoicePaid and OrderPaid and calls localAPI AcceptOrder for Pending orders whose invoice is Paid. AfterCronJob catches leftovers missed by a gateway and optionally deletes stale Unpaid + Pending orders. Refunded, Cancelled, Collections, Fraud, and non-Pending orders are never modified. Zero-amount invoices that WHMCS marks Paid are treated as paid.
features: Accept paid pending orders immediately on InvoicePaid / OrderPaid
AfterCronJob catch-up for leftover Paid + Pending orders
Optional delete of stale Unpaid + Pending orders (default 6 hours)
Never touches Refunded, Cancelled, Collections, Fraud, or non-Pending orders
Admin log with today counts and last error
